title: How Reliable is AI-Generated Audio Description? A Multilingual Expert Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29658v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Audio description (AD) makes visual media, such as video, accessible to blind or low-vision (BLV) audiences, but the high cost of professional production limits coverage. Due to recent advances in AI, numerous approaches to automatically generate intermediate AD scripts and/or final AD audios have been proposed. We present an expert evaluation of AI-generated AD scripts for movies in Italian and German that compares two AI systems, a GPT-4o- and a Qwen-based pipeline, against human-authored descriptions. Professional audio describers rated description quality and annotated errors using a detailed error taxonomy that includes content, character, fluency and coherence errors. The results show that while GPT-4o outperforms the Qwen models, both AI systems still fall short of human professional quality: the generated descriptions show substantially higher error rates and lower quality ratings. translated_title: AI生成的音频描述有多可靠？一项多语言专家评估
translated_abstract: 音频描述（AD）使盲人或低视力（BLV）观众能够无障碍地访问视频等视觉媒体，但专业制作的高昂成本限制了其覆盖范围。得益于人工智能的最新进展，已有许多自动生成中间AD脚本和/或最终AD音频的方法被提出。我们对意大利语和德语电影的AI生成AD脚本进行了一项专家评估，将两个AI系统——基于GPT-4o和基于Qwen的流水线——与人工撰写的描述进行对比。专业音频描述员对描述质量进行评分，并使用涵盖内容、角色、流畅性和连贯性错误的详细错误分类体系对错误进行标注。结果表明，尽管GPT-4o的表现优于Qwen模型，但两个AI系统仍未能达到人类专业水平：生成的描述呈现出明显更高的错误率和更低的质量评分。基于错误标注，我们识别出两个……
tldr: 该研究通过对意大利语和德语电影进行多语言专家评估，发现尽管GPT-4o优于基于Qwen的系统，AI生成的音频描述在错误率和质量评分上仍显著低于人类专业描述员的水平。
en_tdlr: This multilingual expert evaluation of AI-generated audio description scripts for Italian and German movies shows that, although GPT-4o outperforms Qwen-based pipelines, both AI systems still fall substantially short of human professional quality, exhibiting higher error rates and lower quality ratings.
